_note: How each world is drawn on the flight map. Nothing here changes the physics; it is what the worlds look like, kept out of the screen code so a colour is never written twice.

light._note: How far the bright spot sits from the middle of a world, as a share of its radius. The direction is worked out: the lit side always faces the Sun, which is why the target changes face as it comes round.

earth._note: Earth is drawn twice: large when the mission orbits it, small when it is only the place you left.

mars._note: A polar cap you can see from Earth with a small telescope.

jupiter._note: Banded clouds, and the Great Red Spot.
